summary: EF 发布新组织结构：协议层、访问层、用户层、社区层、机构层五个领域集群，另有运营与管理集群，同时减少 54 人，约占 20%。Vitalik 说明 EF 今年预算削减约 40%，向以长期捐赠基金为基础的组织转型。前 EF 协议研究人员成立非营利研发机构 Ethlabs。EIP-8222 Lean Staking 合并，它在 ACDE #238 上介绍过通过隐私池进行质押存款和提款。ethbeat 把 STRK20 加入隐私看板，指出单个管理员账户可以看到所有屏蔽转账。Aztec 在 L2BEAT 达到 Stage 2。

items.title: EF 博客：EF 的新结构
items.note: EF 结束数月重组，作为执行 Mandate 与 Treasury Management Policy 的一部分，现有协议层、访问层、用户层、社区层、机构层五个领域集群，另有运营集群和管理集群；同事减少 54 人，约占 EF 的 20%。协议集群负责硬化和扩展协议，把审查与俘获抗性、开源、隐私和安全作为不可妥协的协议保证，包括防御有害 MEV 和特权订单流，把后量子、zkEVM、L1 隐私等长期研究转化为协议改动；访问层负责让个人和代表他们的代理在读链、交易、证明、委托和退出时获得 CROPS 属性。
items.title_en: EF blog: The EF's new structure
items.note_en: . The EF concluded a months-long reorganization as part of implementing the Mandate and the Treasury Management Policy. It now has five domain clusters (protocol, access, user, community and institutional layers) plus an operations cluster and a management cluster, with 54 fewer colleagues, about 20% of the EF. The protocol cluster hardens and scales the protocol, treating censorship and capture resistance, open source, privacy and security as non-negotiable protocol guarantees, including defending against toxic MEV and privileged orderflow and turning long-horizon research such as post-quantum, zkEVM and L1 privacy into protocol changes. The access layer makes CROPS properties real for individuals, and the agents acting for them, when reading the chain, transacting, proving, delegating and exiting.

items.title: Vitalik：EF 今年预算削减约 40%，需要做出一些艰难决定
items.note: 21:44，目标是转型为面向长期、以捐赠基金为基础的组织。据 Ethereal news #29 的总结，削减涉及客户端（多客户端模式从冗余转向专业分工，探索 AI 辅助形式化验证）、PSE（Privacy Stewards of Ethereum 收缩，转为专注实现而非探索 ZKP 隐私与扩容）、Devcon（更小更简朴）等。
items.title_en: Vitalik: the EF is cutting its budget by roughly 40% this year, which entails some difficult decisions
items.note_en: 21:44, as it transitions to a long-term, endowment-based organization. Per Ethereal news #29's summary, the cuts touch clients (the multi-client model shifting from redundancy to specialization, exploring AI-assisted formal verification), PSE (Privacy Stewards of Ethereum winding down, focusing on implementing rather than exploring ZKP privacy and scaling), Devcon (smaller and more spartan) and more.

items.title: ethlabs_org：宣布 Ethlabs，以太坊与 ETH 的非营利研发实验室
items.note: 00:03。据 Ethlabs 官网的 Thesis 页面，其使命是让以太坊成为全球经济的结算层；团队与用户、应用、钱包、L2、基础设施团队、机构、ETH 持有者、核心开发者和研究者合作，把实际需求转化为协议工作、共享标准、基础设施和产品，并称自己是“多节点未来”中的一个节点。
items.title_en: ethlabs_org: announcing Ethlabs, a non-profit R&D lab for Ethereum and ETH
items.note_en: 00:03. According to the Thesis page on the Ethlabs website, its mission is to make Ethereum the settlement layer of the global economy; the team works with users, applications, wallets, L2s, infrastructure teams, institutions, ETH holders, core devs and researchers to turn real needs into protocol work, shared standards, infrastructure and shipped products, and describes itself as one node in a "multi-node future".

EIP-8222 Lean Staking was merged; it had been presented at ACDE #238 as staking deposits and withdrawals through a privacy pool. ethbeat added STRK20 to its privacy dashboard and noted that a single admin account can see all shielded transfers.
